definitions.explanation: The dismissal of a public official or minister from their post by an authority. A formal, often political term; {罷免|ひめん}する is the verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{罷免|ひめん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{罷免|ひめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister decided to dismiss the minister.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{罷免|ひめん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Removing a judge from office requires special procedures.

notes:
A formal term for the involuntary removal of an official from office, typically by a superior authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {罷免|ひめん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dismiss (from office)
- {罷免|ひめん}{権|けん}: power of dismissal
- ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{罷免|ひめん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dismiss a minister

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧: dismissal from a duty or position — broader, also used in business
- ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧: dismissal of an employee, firing — ordinary employment
